name: How can I evaluate a contractor's expertise in plumbing and electrical coordination?
description: Ask for references, inquire about their coordination process, and seek examples of successful projects to evaluate a contractor's expertise.

mainEntity.name: How can I evaluate a contractor's expertise in plumbing and electrical coordination?

acceptedAnswer.text: To evaluate a contractor's expertise, ask for references from previous projects that involved significant plumbing and electrical work. Inquire about their process for coordinating trades and how they handle unforeseen conflicts. A reputable contractor will have a clear methodology for collaboration and be able to provide examples of successful projects where complex systems were integrated effectively. Look for contractors with experience in your specific type of project.
